STAT_BYTES_RECEIVED : Bytes received within last session (download)
STAT_BYTES_SENT : Bytes sent within last session (upload)
STAT_PHONE_NO : Telephone number of the RAS server
STAT_MODE : Digital, analogues or other dial-in
STAT_SIM_MNC : MNC (mobile network code) of SIM
STAT_SIM_MCC : MCC (mobile country code) of SIM
STAT_IP_NO : IP-number of the last connection.
